app.name: Sahayak
app.tagline: Patient follow-up that works even offline
app.description: Follow-up care for community health workers, even offline

login.title: Worker login
login.subtitle: Enter your worker ID and PIN to continue.
login.lockedOut: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
login.noSavedAccount: No saved account for this ID on this device. Connect to the internet and sign in once to set it up.
login.connectionError: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
login.unlockOffline: You are offline. Enter your PIN to unlock.
login.waking: Waking up the server, this can take up to a minute.
login.timeoutError: The server is taking too long. Please try again.

home.emptyBody: Check back later, or register a new patient.
home.urgentExplain: High risk at the last check-up — follow up first.
home.dueTodayExplain: Their next check-up is scheduled for today.
home.overdueExplain: These check-ups are past their due date.
home.upcomingExplain: Check-ups already scheduled ahead of time.
home.waitingSyncExplain: Saved on this device — not on the server yet.
home.legendHint: Urgent, clinic and home describe the result of the patient's last check-up.
home.nothingDueBody: All check-ups for today are done.
home.nothingAllBody: Register a patient to start follow-up care.
home.nothingSyncBody: All changes are on the server now.
home.offlineBody: Changes stay safe on this device and sync when you're back online.
home.errorBody: Something went wrong on this device. Try again.
home.showingFirst: Showing the first {{n}} — the rest are in Patients.

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: Care across your villages
insights.riskSummary: Patients counted by their last check-up result.
insights.emptyBody: Register patients and log visits to see insights here.

status.slowSync: Taking longer than usual — the server may be waking up.
status.authExpired: Session expired. Log in again to keep syncing.

patients.title: Patients
patients.showingFirst: Showing first {{count}} of {{total}} — refine your search.

patientNew.title: New patient
patientNew.name: Patient name
patientNew.consentBody: We will store this patient's name, contact details and health readings to help with follow-up care. This data is shared only with your health programme. We never sell or misuse it.
patientNew.consentCheckbox: The patient agrees to store this information

detail.title: Patient
detail.noVisitsBody: Log the first visit to start tracking

visit.title: Log visit
visit.implausibleBody: This reading does not look right. Please measure once more before saving.
visit.tbRequired: Add at least one detail first: doses missed, medicine, symptoms, or notes.
visit.micUnsupported: Voice notes not supported on this device
visit.micPrompt: Speak now, tap the button again to stop

risk.listenMissing: No voice is installed for this language on your device.

reason.PREG_HIGH_BP: Blood pressure is high in pregnancy
reason.PREG_DANGER_SIGN: A pregnancy danger sign is present

reason.IMPLAUSIBLE_READING: The reading looks like a measurement error

reminder.title: Reminder
reminder.noPhone: This patient has no phone number
reminder.shareNotice: Sending opens WhatsApp or SMS with the patient's name and visit details. Only send with the patient's consent.
reminder.noNextDate: Please come to the health centre soon.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirmBody: This deletes all patients and visits on this device. Synced data on the server stays.
settings.syncIssuesBody: {{count}} records were not accepted by the server. They stay on this device only — ask your supervisor if you need them fixed.
settings.syncIssuesBodyOne: 1 record was not accepted by the server. It stays on this device only.
settings.disclaimer: Sahayak supports your decisions. It does not replace a doctor.

landing.title: Sahayak
landing.tagline: Offline patient follow-up for community health workers
landing.feature1: Works completely offline — no internet needed in the field
landing.feature2: Tracks patients, visits, and risk with clinical rules
